title: first-touch-sweep --self-test runs in no CI job (no alias, no lint.yml step)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36220 (PR #36378). Found by the dev, confirmed by L1-d (7076861215); filed by the seat.

## What happens

`node scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs --self-test` (85 cases across 7 batteries after #36378) is run by no CI job, and the root `package.json` has no alias for it. `check-self-test-wired` does not count it, because CI never runs the script. So every pin in it, the new North Star area-list battery included, guards only a hand run, and a regression in the sweep can land green. This predates #36378.

## To do

1. Add a root `package.json` alias (for example `check:first-touch-sweep`) that runs the self-test.
2. Add a step to the repo-tooling job in `.github/workflows/lint.yml` that runs it. That file is a governed surface, so this lands as Tier S.
3. Check that `check-self-test-wired` now counts the script.

## Acceptance

- The lint job on a PR runs the self-test, and a deliberately broken case turns it red. Show that once in the PR body, then revert it.

## Grade
p3 · area:fleet · domain:devx. A pin that no gate runs.
